request.style: English, male jazz baritone, upright bass, brushed drums, brushed cymbals, upright piano, warm smoky mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Lord spoke clear to me, a sign
Take a large tablet, let it be
Write the name with stylus plain
For Maher-shalal-hash-baz it must remain

[Chorus]
I took reliable witnesses for myself
Uriah the priest, a steadfast shelf
Zechariah son of Jeberechiah
Trust in the word, in the holy day

[Verse]
In Judah’s days, under King Ahaz
A prophetic act of grace
The name was set on the stone
A truth that would not be alone

[Chorus]
I took reliable witnesses for myself
Uriah the priest, a steadfast shelf
Zechariah son of Jeberechiah
Trust in the word, in the holy day

[Bridge]
Before the boy can say father or mother
The spoils of Samaria, the Damascus weather
Carried off before the king of Assyria
The prophecy stands, the witness near

[Outro]
Zechariah son of Jeberechiah
A name remembered in the book of Isaiah
